## ROLEPLAY RULES - These apply during gameplay.
- [textlink="1. Don't act like an antagonist unless the game says you are one." link="RulePSR1"] - [textlink="2. As a crew-aligned non-antagonist, follow reasonable escalation." link="RulePSR2"] - [textlink="3. Don't interfere with players joining, leaving, or ending the round." link="RulePSR3"] - [textlink="4. You are expected to roleplay without breaking immersion." link="RulePSR4"] - [textlink="5. Don't use information gained outside of in-character means." link="RulePSR5"] - [textlink="6. Do not metagame; Obey the Metashield." link="RulePSR6"] - [textlink="7. Don't give unfair treatment based on who is playing a character." link="RulePSR7"] - [textlink="8. Listen to your team leader and don't abandon your role." link="RulePSR8"] \n
